revision.revised_text: `strings.Contains(d, "domain")` (beacon.go:184) also catches sender-side failures such as "Sending domain not verified". It applies to any report with status `failed` whose details contain "domain", have no SMTP 4.x.x/5.x.x code (beacon.go:171-176), and match none of the soft phrases (beacon.go:177-181). Such reports return a hard bounce. With the default `bounce.actions` (hard: count 1, action `blocklist`, schema.sql:19), our own DNS mistake would blocklist healthy contacts. Could this match narrower phrases, or treat the rest as soft?
